verdict.rationale: Washington ESD runs online employer services (eServices/EAMS) for quarterly tax and wage filing. Scheduled or recurring automated filings or payments are a plausible capability for such a portal, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only manual online, mail, email or fax filing behind a login wall; there is no background automation, scheduling or API (OpenAPI probes returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
